summary:
Held 0 of today's 10 biggest US movers.

• 6 upside misses — COHR +18%, MPWR +16%, AMD +14%, TER +13%, FERG +12%. These cleared the universe screen but no strategy picked them up; the morning brief either filtered them on a catalyst/RSI/earnings rule or had nothing positive to trigger an entry.

• 4 downside moves (NVDA -5%, FSLR -4%, TTWO -3%, AXON -3%) are unreachable on a long-only basket — no mechanism to express a short or pair-trade.

• Most instructive miss: COHR (+17.77%) — No confirmed same-day news found. Likely continued AI-optics momentum after the Nov 4 Q1 FY27 beat (revenue +50% to $2.37B, FY27 growth guided above 60%), possibly with a sector rally. Why we passed: Outside any active strategy's universe: COHR is a mid/large-cap optical/photonics name that no strategy includes. A multi-day post-earnings drift with no single-day gap trigger would also be hard for a news-reactive bot to catch.
